content.rendered:
FarmAdvice is a mobile application that bundles three agricultural calculators:

Herbicide Calculator: Uses land measurements and pre-set parameters to determine the correct herbicide quantity.
Seed Calculator: Calculates seed requirements for seven crops (cassava, yam, rice, sweet potato, cowpea, maize, and soybeans) based on land size and planting type, assuming 100% germination.
Fertilizer Calculator: Recommends fertilizer bag quantities for the same seven crops using NPK ratios.

Platform: Android
Contact: Oyewale Abioye
o.abioye@cgiar.org

content.rendered:
Citizen H2D3 develops a data-rich system to support decision-making on food security actions in Rwanda by assessing changes in diet quality at various locations and over time. The system will leverage on the principles of citizen science and digital tools to provide evidence-driven and robust insights about the dynamics of diet quality with the aim of empowering decision makers who are keen to formulate and implement evidence-based policies and interventions.

Platform: android&ios
Contact: Rhys Manners
R.Manners@cgiar.org

App Benefits

Citizen H2D3 will enable stakeholders to establish linkages between diets and environmental (e.g. climatic, physical, agro-ecological) and socio-economic (e.g. gender, income, assets etc) covariates. The project will also serve as a learning platform for generating protocols and best practices for deriving citizen-driven data collection methods in the diet and nutrition domains for embedding in activities of next and end users of Citizen-H2D3.

content.rendered:
AKILIMO is a digital advisory service for smallholder cassava growers in Nigeria and Tanzania. It provides customized advice on fertilizer use, best planting practices and weed control, intercropping and planting and harvest schedules. AKILIMO leverages advances in agronomy at scale and big data analytics, using digital soil maps and satellite-based recommendations to provided advice tailored to farmers’ individual fields that maximize returns on investment. AKILIMO is available through printable guides and worksheets, as a smartphone app, and on simple phones through VIAMO’s 321 service and Arifu’s chatbot. Over 30 ground partners from the public and private sector promote the use of AKILIMO through grassroot events.

Platform: android
Contact: Pieter Pypers
P.Pypers@cgiar.org

App Benefits
AKILIMO has over 180,000 registered users and an uptake rate of over 75%. Average benefits have been estimated at US$ 120 per household per year, based on observed yield responses and price records. Increased profits are most often obtained through investments resulting in increased root yields, but also through smarter decision making, reduced investment costs and monitoring market trends and harvesting at opportune times to obtain higher prices for the root produce.
